concept.cypher: MATCH (lt:Type {fqn: 'org.slf4j.Logger'})-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE coalesce(m.name, last(split(split(m.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) IN ['trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'] SET m:LogCall RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS LogCalls

constraint.description: Query strings routinely carry tokens: never log HttpServletRequest#getQueryString.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(q:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(rt:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND coalesce(q.name, last(split(split(q.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'getQueryString' AND rt.fqn IN ['jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest', 'javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest'] AND EXISTS { MATCH (m)-[:INVOKES]->(:Method:LogCall) } RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'getQueryString and log call in the same method' AS Detail
